description: Read-only list of the products (vendors) covered, to look up ids before calling get_tool or compare_tools. Returns `count` and `tools`, each with `id`, `name`, `vendor`, `dataset`, `checked` (date the vendor page was last read), `plans` (count) and `page` URL; no prices or limits, those live in get_tool. Without `dataset` it returns every product across all datasets (about 100 rows); with `dataset` only that one. Not paginated, no auth, no side effects. When the user already names a product, skip this and call get_tool or search_limits directly.

dataset.description: Dataset id to list. One of: ai-plans, usage, email-sending, llm-apis, media, plans-new, scraping-proxies, search-apis, voice. Omit to cover every dataset.

name: list_tools
title: List products in a dataset
